```{r}

############################################################
# Host–microbiome correlation analysis
# Shortlisted fungi/viruses vs cytokines, metabolites,
# and gestational age at delivery
############################################################

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggpubr)

project_root <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project"
data_dir     <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
results_dir  <- file.path(project_root, "Results")
figures_dir  <- file.path(project_root, "Figures")

metadata_file_tsv <- file.path(data_dir, "metadata_clean.tsv")

fungal_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_fungal_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

viral_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_viral_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

output_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "host_microbiome_correlations")
figure_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "host_microbiome_correlations")

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

shortlisted_fungi <- c(
  "Puccinia",
  "Saccharomyces",
  "Aspergillus",
  "Cryptococcus",
  "Fusarium",
  "Lachancea",
  "Rhizophagus",
  "Trichoderma",
  "Drechmeria",
  "Eremothecium",
  "Schizosaccharomyces",
  "Sugiyamaella",
  "Thermothelomyces",
  "Zymoseptoria"
)

shortlisted_viruses <- c(
  "Shenzhenivirus",
  "Certrevirus",
  "Cukevirus",
  "Fohxhuevirus",
  "Oryzopoxvirus",
  "Cytomegalovirus",
  "Gorganvirus",
  "Moturavirus",
  "Shandvirus"
)

metabolite_cols <- c(
  "Acetate", "Alanine", "Asparagine", "Aspartate",
  "Cadaverine_t", "Lysine", "Choline", "Ethanol",
  "Formate", "Glucose", "Maltose", "Glutamate",
  "Glutamine", "Isoleucine", "Lactate", "Leucine",
  "Methionine", "Phenylalanine", "Putrescine",
  "Succinate", "Threonine", "Tyrosine", "Tyramine",
  "Uracil", "Valine", "Pyruvate", "Taurine",
  "Betaine", "Tryptophan"
)

cytokine_cols <- c(
  "C5", "C5a", "GCSF", "IFNg", "IgM",
  "IL10", "IL13", "IL17A", "IL22",
  "IL5", "IL6", "IL8", "MCP1",
  "IL37_pg_mL"
)

outcome_cols <- c(
  "sample_label",
  "reads_ID",
  "bmi",
  "outcome",
  "sPTB34",
  "Ges_del_days"
)

meta <- read.delim(
  metadata_file_tsv,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"

required_cols <- c(
  outcome_cols,
  metabolite_cols,
  cytokine_cols
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(meta))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "These required metadata columns are missing: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

meta$bmi <- as.numeric(meta$bmi)
meta$Ges_del_days <- as.numeric(meta$Ges_del_days)

meta$outcome <- factor(
  meta$outcome,
  levels = c("TERM", "sPTB")
)

meta$sPTB34 <- factor(
  meta$sPTB34,
  levels = c("no", "yes")
)

read_microbiome_matrix <- function(file_path, meta) {
  
  mat <- read.delim(
    file_path,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  matrix_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(mat))
  
  unmatched <- setdiff(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)
  
  if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Unmatched samples found: ",
      paste(unmatched, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  meta_matched <- meta[
    match(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID),
  ]
  
  if (!all(meta_matched$reads_ID == matrix_ids_clean)) {
    stop("Metadata order mismatch")
  }
  
  rownames(mat) <- matrix_ids_clean
  rownames(meta_matched) <- matrix_ids_clean
  
  mat <- as.data.frame(mat)
  mat[] <- lapply(mat, as.numeric)
  
  return(
    list(
      mat = mat,
      meta = meta_matched
    )
  )
}

relative_abundance_if_needed <- function(mat) {
  
  row_sums <- rowSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (max(mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 1 || median(row_sums, na.rm = TRUE) > 1.5) {
    mat <- sweep(mat, 1, row_sums, "/")
    mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  }
  
  return(mat)
}

log_transform_abundance <- function(mat) {
  
  min_positive <- min(mat[mat > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  pseudocount <- min_positive / 2
  
  mat_log <- log10(mat + pseudocount)
  
  return(mat_log)
}

prepare_host_matrix <- function(meta, selected_cols) {
  
  host <- meta[, selected_cols, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(host) <- meta$reads_ID
  
  host[] <- lapply(host, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  
  for (feature in colnames(host)) {
    
    x <- host[[feature]]
    
    if (all(is.na(x))) next
    
    if (min(x, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0) {
      
      min_positive <- min(x[x > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
      
      if (is.finite(min_positive)) {
        x <- log10(x + min_positive / 2)
      }
    }
    
    host[[feature]] <- as.numeric(scale(x))
  }
  
  return(host)
}

fungal_obj <- read_microbiome_matrix(fungal_file, meta)
viral_obj  <- read_microbiome_matrix(viral_file, meta)

fungal_mat <- fungal_obj$mat
viral_mat  <- viral_obj$mat

fungal_mat <- relative_abundance_if_needed(fungal_mat)
viral_mat  <- relative_abundance_if_needed(viral_mat)

fungal_mat_log <- log_transform_abundance(fungal_mat)
viral_mat_log  <- log_transform_abundance(viral_mat)

fungal_short <- fungal_mat_log[
  ,
  intersect(shortlisted_fungi, colnames(fungal_mat_log)),
  drop = FALSE
]

viral_short <- viral_mat_log[
  ,
  intersect(shortlisted_viruses, colnames(viral_mat_log)),
  drop = FALSE
]

missing_fungi <- setdiff(shortlisted_fungi, colnames(fungal_short))
missing_viruses <- setdiff(shortlisted_viruses, colnames(viral_short))

if (length(missing_fungi) > 0) {
  warning(
    "These shortlisted fungal taxa were not found in the fungal matrix: ",
    paste(missing_fungi, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (length(missing_viruses) > 0) {
  warning(
    "These shortlisted viral taxa were not found in the viral matrix: ",
    paste(missing_viruses, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cytokines <- prepare_host_matrix(meta, cytokine_cols)
metabolites <- prepare_host_matrix(meta, metabolite_cols)

gestational_age <- meta %>%
  select(reads_ID, Ges_del_days) %>%
  mutate(Ges_del_days = as.numeric(Ges_del_days)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("reads_ID")

run_taxa_host_associations <- function(taxa_mat, host_mat, meta, taxa_group, host_group) {
  
  common_ids <- Reduce(
    intersect,
    list(
      rownames(taxa_mat),
      rownames(host_mat),
      meta$reads_ID
    )
  )
  
  taxa_mat <- taxa_mat[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  host_mat <- host_mat[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  meta_use <- meta[match(common_ids, meta$reads_ID), ]
  
  results <- list()
  
  for (taxon in colnames(taxa_mat)) {
    
    for (host_feature in colnames(host_mat)) {
      
      df <- data.frame(
        sample_id = common_ids,
        taxon_value = taxa_mat[[taxon]],
        host_value = host_mat[[host_feature]],
        bmi = meta_use$bmi,
        outcome = meta_use$outcome
      ) %>%
        filter(
          is.finite(taxon_value),
          is.finite(host_value),
          is.finite(bmi),
          !is.na(outcome)
        )
      
      if (nrow(df) < 15) next
      
      spearman_test <- suppressWarnings(
        cor.test(
          df$taxon_value,
          df$host_value,
          method = "spearman",
          exact = FALSE
        )
      )
      
      model_bmi <- lm(
        host_value ~ taxon_value + bmi,
        data = df
      )
      
      model_bmi_outcome <- lm(
        host_value ~ taxon_value + bmi + outcome,
        data = df
      )
      
      model_bmi_taxon <- tidy(model_bmi) %>%
        filter(term == "taxon_value")
      
      model_bmi_outcome_taxon <- tidy(model_bmi_outcome) %>%
        filter(term == "taxon_value")
      
      results[[paste(taxon, host_feature, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
        taxa_group = taxa_group,
        host_group = host_group,
        taxon = taxon,
        host_feature = host_feature,
        n = nrow(df),
        spearman_rho = unname(spearman_test$estimate),
        spearman_p = spearman_test$p.value,
        bmi_adjusted_beta = model_bmi_taxon$estimate,
        bmi_adjusted_p = model_bmi_taxon$p.value,
        bmi_adjusted_r2 = glance(model_bmi)$r.squared,
        bmi_outcome_adjusted_beta = model_bmi_outcome_taxon$estimate,
        bmi_outcome_adjusted_p = model_bmi_outcome_taxon$p.value,
        bmi_outcome_adjusted_r2 = glance(model_bmi_outcome)$r.squared
      )
    }
  }
  
  results_df <- bind_rows(results) %>%
    mutate(
      spearman_q = p.adjust(spearman_p, method = "BH"),
      bmi_adjusted_q = p.adjust(bmi_adjusted_p, method = "BH"),
      bmi_outcome_adjusted_q = p.adjust(bmi_outcome_adjusted_p, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    arrange(spearman_p)
  
  return(results_df)
}

fungi_cytokines <- run_taxa_host_associations(
  taxa_mat = fungal_short,
  host_mat = cytokines,
  meta = meta,
  taxa_group = "Fungi",
  host_group = "Cytokines"
)

viruses_cytokines <- run_taxa_host_associations(
  taxa_mat = viral_short,
  host_mat = cytokines,
  meta = meta,
  taxa_group = "Viruses",
  host_group = "Cytokines"
)

fungi_metabolites <- run_taxa_host_associations(
  taxa_mat = fungal_short,
  host_mat = metabolites,
  meta = meta,
  taxa_group = "Fungi",
  host_group = "Metabolites"
)

viruses_metabolites <- run_taxa_host_associations(
  taxa_mat = viral_short,
  host_mat = metabolites,
  meta = meta,
  taxa_group = "Viruses",
  host_group = "Metabolites"
)

fungi_gestational_age <- run_taxa_host_associations(
  taxa_mat = fungal_short,
  host_mat = gestational_age,
  meta = meta,
  taxa_group = "Fungi",
  host_group = "Gestational age at delivery"
)

viruses_gestational_age <- run_taxa_host_associations(
  taxa_mat = viral_short,
  host_mat = gestational_age,
  meta = meta,
  taxa_group = "Viruses",
  host_group = "Gestational age at delivery"
)

all_results <- bind_rows(
  fungi_cytokines,
  viruses_cytokines,
  fungi_metabolites,
  viruses_metabolites,
  fungi_gestational_age,
  viruses_gestational_age
)

all_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      spearman_rho > 0 ~ "Positive association",
      spearman_rho < 0 ~ "Negative association",
      TRUE ~ "No direction"
    ),
    interpretation_level = case_when(
      spearman_q < 0.05 |
        bmi_adjusted_q < 0.05 |
        bmi_outcome_adjusted_q < 0.05 ~ "FDR-significant",
      spearman_p < 0.05 |
        bmi_adjusted_p < 0.05 |
        bmi_outcome_adjusted_p < 0.05 ~ "Nominally significant",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

write.csv(
  all_results,
  file.path(output_dir, "all_taxa_host_association_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

nominal_results <- all_results %>%
  filter(interpretation_level != "Not significant") %>%
  arrange(spearman_p)

write.csv(
  nominal_results,
  file.path(output_dir, "nominally_significant_taxa_host_associations.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

ranked_summary <- all_results %>%
  arrange(spearman_p)

write.csv(
  ranked_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "ranked_taxa_host_association_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

plot_association_heatmap <- function(results_df, title, output_name) {
  
  if (nrow(results_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  rho_mat <- results_df %>%
    select(taxon, host_feature, spearman_rho) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = host_feature,
      values_from = spearman_rho
    ) %>%
    column_to_rownames("taxon") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  sig_mat <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        spearman_q < 0.05 ~ "**",
        spearman_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    ) %>%
    select(taxon, host_feature, sig) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = host_feature,
      values_from = sig
    ) %>%
    column_to_rownames("taxon") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  pheatmap(
    rho_mat,
    display_numbers = sig_mat,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    main = title,
    filename = file.path(figure_dir, output_name),
    width = 11,
    height = 6
  )
}

plot_association_heatmap(
  fungi_cytokines,
  "Shortlisted fungal taxa vs cytokines",
  "fungi_vs_cytokines_heatmap.pdf"
)

plot_association_heatmap(
  viruses_cytokines,
  "Shortlisted viral taxa vs cytokines",
  "viruses_vs_cytokines_heatmap.pdf"
)

plot_association_heatmap(
  fungi_metabolites,
  "Shortlisted fungal taxa vs metabolites",
  "fungi_vs_metabolites_heatmap.pdf"
)

plot_association_heatmap(
  viruses_metabolites,
  "Shortlisted viral taxa vs metabolites",
  "viruses_vs_metabolites_heatmap.pdf"
)


message("Analysis complete.")
message("Results saved to: ", output_dir)
message("Figures saved to: ", figure_dir)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Taxa selection
############################################################


library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

focused_plot_dir <- file.path(figure_dir, "focused_thesis_plots_PTB_guided")

dir.create(
  focused_plot_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# -----------------------------
# Associations to plot
# -----------------------------

focused_hits <- tribble(
  ~taxa_group, ~host_group, ~taxon,          ~host_feature,   ~figure_reason,

  # PTB-linked fungal immune associations
  "Fungi",     "Cytokines",   "Aspergillus",  "IL37_pg_mL",   "Stable PTB-associated fungal taxon with immune association",
  "Fungi",     "Cytokines",   "Fusarium",     "IL37_pg_mL",   "Stable PTB-associated fungal taxon with immune association",

  # PTB-linked clinical association
  "Fungi",     "Gestational age at delivery", "Aspergillus", "Ges_del_days", "Stable PTB-associated fungal taxon linked to gestational age",

  # PTB-linked viral immune association
  "Viruses",   "Cytokines",   "Shenzhenivirus", "IL6",        "Stable PTB-associated viral taxon with inflammatory cytokine association",

  # PTB-linked fungal metabolite associations
  "Fungi",     "Metabolites", "Cryptococcus", "Succinate",    "Stable sPTB34-associated fungal taxon with dysbiosis-related metabolite association",
  "Fungi",     "Metabolites", "Puccinia",     "Succinate",    "Stable sPTB34-associated fungal taxon with dysbiosis-related metabolite association",

  # Strong exploratory metabolite associations
  "Viruses",   "Metabolites", "Fohxhuevirus", "Putrescine",   "Strongest exploratory viral-metabolite association",
  "Viruses",   "Metabolites", "Fohxhuevirus", "Lactate",      "Exploratory viral-metabolite association linked to vaginal homeostasis"
)

# Keep only associations that were actually significant in the results table
focused_hits <- focused_hits %>%
  inner_join(
    all_results %>%
      filter(
        spearman_q < 0.05 |
          bmi_adjusted_q < 0.05 |
          bmi_outcome_adjusted_q < 0.05
      ),
    by = c("taxa_group", "host_group", "taxon", "host_feature")
  )
############################################################
# Publication display labels
############################################################

display_labels <- c(

  # Cytokines
  "IL37_pg_mL" = "IL-37",
  "IL6" = "IL-6",
  "IL8" = "IL-8",
  "IL10" = "IL-10",
  "IFNg" = "Interferon-γ",
  "GCSF" = "G-CSF",
  "C5" = "Complement C5",
  "C5a" = "Complement C5a",
  "IgM" = "Immunoglobulin M (IgM)",
  "MCP1" = "MCP-1",

  # Metabolites
  "Putrescine" = "Putrescine",
  "Cadaverine_t" = "Cadaverine",
  "Tyramine" = "Tyramine",
  "Succinate" = "Succinate",
  "Lactate" = "Lactate",
  "Phenylalanine" = "Phenylalanine",
  "Tyrosine" = "Tyrosine",
  "Glutamine" = "Glutamine",
  "Glutamate" = "Glutamate",
  "Formate" = "Formate",

  # Clinical variables
  "Ges_del_days" = "Gestational Age"
)

# -----------------------------
# Clean plotting function
# -----------------------------

make_clean_focused_plot <- function(taxa_group,
                                    host_group,
                                    taxon,
                                    host_feature,
                                    figure_reason) {

  if (taxa_group == "Fungi") {
    taxa_mat <- fungal_short
  } else {
    taxa_mat <- viral_short
  }

  if (host_group == "Metabolites") {
  host_mat <- metabolites
  } else if (host_group == "Cytokines") {
  host_mat <- cytokines
  } else {
  host_mat <- gestational_age
  }

  common_ids <- Reduce(
    intersect,
    list(
      rownames(taxa_mat),
      rownames(host_mat),
      meta$reads_ID
    )
  )

  meta_use <- meta[match(common_ids, meta$reads_ID), ]

  df <- data.frame(
    sample_id = common_ids,
    sample_label = meta_use$sample_label,
    taxon_value = taxa_mat[common_ids, taxon],
    host_value = host_mat[common_ids, host_feature],
    outcome = meta_use$outcome,
    sPTB34 = meta_use$sPTB34
  ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(taxon_value),
      is.finite(host_value),
      !is.na(outcome)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      delivery_group = case_when(
        outcome == "TERM" ~ "TERM",
        outcome == "sPTB" & sPTB34 == "no" ~ "sPTB 34-37",
        outcome == "sPTB" & sPTB34 == "yes" ~ "sPTB <34",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      delivery_group = factor(
        delivery_group,
        levels = c("TERM", "sPTB 34-37", "sPTB <34")
      )
    )

  stats_row <- all_results %>%
    filter(
      taxa_group == !!taxa_group,
      host_group == !!host_group,
      taxon == !!taxon,
      host_feature == !!host_feature
    ) %>%
    slice(1)

display_host_feature <- ifelse(
  host_feature %in% names(display_labels),
  display_labels[[host_feature]],
  host_feature
)

figure_title <- paste(
  taxon,
  "vs",
  display_host_feature
)

x_axis_label <- paste(
  "Log-transformed",
  taxon,
  "abundance"
)

if (host_group == "Metabolites") {

  y_axis_label <- paste(
    "Scaled",
    display_host_feature,
    "concentration"
  )

} else if (host_group == "Cytokines") {

  y_axis_label <- paste(
    "Scaled",
    display_host_feature,
    "concentration"
  )

} else {

  y_axis_label <- "Gestational age at delivery (days)"
}

  label_text <- paste0(
    "Spearman rho = ", round(stats_row$spearman_rho, 2),
    ", q = ", signif(stats_row$spearman_q, 2),
    ", n = ", stats_row$n
  )

  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      x = taxon_value,
      y = host_value
    )
  ) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(colour = delivery_group),
      width = 0.025,
      height = 0.025,
      size = 1.7,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.65,
      fill = "grey75"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = label_text,
      hjust = -0.04,
      vjust = 1.4,
      size = 3.2
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        "TERM" = "#1f77b4",
        "sPTB 34-37" = "#9467bd",
        "sPTB <34" = "#ff7f0e"
      ),
      na.value = "grey60"
    ) +
    labs(
    title = figure_title,
    x = x_axis_label,
    y = y_axis_label,
    colour = "Delivery group"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey90"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )

  file_safe_taxon <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", taxon)
  file_safe_host <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", host_feature)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      focused_plot_dir,
      paste0(
        taxa_group,
        "_",
        host_group,
        "_",
        file_safe_taxon,
        "_vs_",
        file_safe_host,
        ".pdf"
      )
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 5.5,
    height = 4.5
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      focused_plot_dir,
      paste0(
        taxa_group,
        "_",
        host_group,
        "_",
        file_safe_taxon,
        "_vs_",
        file_safe_host,
        ".png"
      )
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 5.5,
    height = 4.5,
    dpi = 300
  )

  return(p)
}

# -----------------------------
# Generate focused plots only
# -----------------------------

focused_plots <- pmap(
  focused_hits %>%
    select(taxa_group, host_group, taxon, host_feature, figure_reason),
  make_clean_focused_plot
)

write.csv(
  focused_hits,
  file.path(focused_plot_dir, "focused_plot_selection_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("Focused PTB-guided thesis plots saved to: ", focused_plot_dir)
```
